description: Resume previously suspended scaling processes for an Auto Scaling Group. Note: Ncloud suspends LAUNCH automatically (administrative suspension) after repeated server-creation failures — spec not offered in the zone, Launch Configuration / image / snapshot problems, server quota exceeded, or repeated failures from a custom image; the cases were expanded on 2026-11-24 and the account now gets an email. It does not resume by itself: fix the cause first, then resume LAUNCH (the guide shows the console Process tab; this tool calls resumeProcesses)

scalingProcessCodeList.description: List of scaling process codes to resume

name: ncloud_resume_processes
